findings.failure_scenario: Server responds 200 with {"nestedNext":{"nextToken":"abc"}} (nestedItems omitted) for request-query-nested-response-body or request-header-nested-response-body. The new RequestQueryNestedResponseBodyResponse/RequestHeaderNestedResponseBodyResponse.fromJson (both added in this PR) construct the model with a null nestedItems because no required-property check is performed, then requestQueryNestedResponseBodySinglePage/requestHeaderNestedResponseBodySinglePage (lines 665, 695, 798, 828) evaluate getNestedItems().getPets() and throw NPE inside the PagedIterable. The adjacent access to the optional nestedNext IS guarded (nestedNext != null && ...), and the pre-existing non-nested equivalents only dereference a top-level getPets(), so this unguarded chained dereference is new behavior introduced by this change.
findings.summary: The new nested continuation-token page mappers dereference res.getValue().getNestedItems() without a null check, so a response body missing nestedItems throws NullPointerException instead of yielding a page.

findings.failure_scenario: Server responds 200 with {"nestedNext":{"next":"http://localhost:3000/..."}} (nestedItems omitted) for the nested-link operation. The adjacent access to nestedNext IS guarded (nestedNext != null && ...), and the pre-existing link equivalents dereference only a top-level getPets(), so this unguarded chained dereference is new behavior introduced by this change.
